ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact of the Trump administration's decision to freeze Medicaid funding in the state.
questions: What are the implications of the Trump administration's decision to freeze Medicaid funding in Minnesota?
How will this decision impact vulnerable populations who rely on Medicaid for healthcare?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and abuse in the Medicaid program, and to highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability in the program.
